identity.tone: Detached, spacious, black-sky quiet, with an optional crystalline attention mode
identity.shape: A low suspension rail opens into a dark orbital chamber; clarity arrives as a separate bright ring, never as a forced merge
identity.intention: Provide Earth-reference-reduced sound design for fictional orbital, vacuum, and astronaut-perspective scenes
identity.arrival_signature: Earth-resonance layers remain absent; a 1.5 Hz protected dyad enters over a thin black-sky field
identity.return_signature: Clarity ring closes first, suspension rail recedes, then a centred ordinary-room tone returns
must_avoid: claiming Delta causes weightlessness or bodily detachment
claiming 40 Hz creates the overview effect
attempting blind 7.83 Hz cancellation with an unrelated inverse sine
treating 777 or 528 Hz as scientifically privileged space frequencies

claims.label: implementation-task
claims.text: 100 Hz left and 101.5 Hz right form a 1.5 Hz binaural difference over headphones.

claims.label: active-research
claims.text: Binaural-beat EEG and behavioural effects remain inconsistent across studies; perceptual and neural responses depend on carrier, beat rate, listener, and method.

claims.label: evidence-backed-finding
claims.text: A measurable 40 Hz auditory steady-state response has been recorded from 400/440 Hz dichotic tones, although it is not equivalent to producing hyper-awareness or the overview effect.

claims.label: symbolic-canon
claims.text: 777 Hz is retained as an optional bright orbital carrier because of the requested aesthetic, not because it is an established cosmic frequency.

claims.label: implementation-task
claims.text: Polarity inversion cancels only audio that is otherwise identical in waveform, amplitude, timing, phase, and channel path. An independently generated 7.83 Hz sine will not reliably remove an unknown baked layer.
claims.source_language: adding a +pi phase shift will flatten the Earth wave to absolute silence

layers.label: Void Delta Low
accessibility_notes: Do not use while driving or when rapid alertness is required

layers.label: 777 Bright Suspension
layers.experiential_intention: thin luminous suspension rather than bass-heavy void
accessibility_notes: High-frequency-sensitive and migraine-sensitive users should leave disabled
Lower carrier is the primary version

layers.label: Orbital Clarity 40
accessibility_notes: May sound rough rather than like a slow beat
Use briefly and at low level

layers.label: Orbital Clarity AM
accessibility_notes: Do not enable simultaneously with 40 Hz binaural during first calibration

layers.label: Earth Point Return
layers.symbolic_meaning: Earth as a visible point of home

phases.label: Cabin Baseline
phases.purpose: Establish a sparse chamber with no Schumann layer.

phases.label: Launch Vestibule
phases.purpose: Introduce the 1.5 Hz suspension rail while preserving a quiet centre.

phases.label: Orbital Arrival
phases.purpose: Open the visual-imagery chamber; optionally choose one clarity layer.

phases.label: Deep-Space Immersion
phases.purpose: Support fictional orbital suspension, vacuum imagery, or overview-oriented visualisation without claiming to reproduce spaceflight.

phases.label: Earthpoint Return
phases.purpose: Close clarity first, recede suspension, and restore a centred home reference.

suspension-bright.description: Uses 777/778.5 Hz instead of the low rail.

clarity-binaural.description: Adds the 400/440 Hz experimental 40 Hz pair.

clarity-am.description: Uses 40 Hz amplitude modulation instead of the binaural pair.

notes: Choose one clarity method at a time
Start low and keep the 777 carrier optional

calibration_assumptions: Suspension and clarity are designed sensations, not guaranteed brain states
open_questions: Does 528 belong in the default orbital worldshape or remain optional?
Should the return tone use 136.1 Hz or a world-specific home cue?
